english.note: Use this mainly when resources, supplies, time, or funds are ample and sufficient.

exampleSentences.english: The company's funds are ample this year, so it is wealthy enough to take on a new project.
exampleSentences.traditional: 公司今年嘅資金好充裕，做新項目都夠用。
